_comment: The price, said once. Stores hosted on kitcommerce.store pay hostedFee of feeBasis, cash on delivery and on-account orders included, in the store's own currency; stores in India pay gstIndia GST on that fee. Running the MIT code yourself is free. The owner's decisions of 26, 27 and 28 October 2026, recorded in docs/decisions.md. feeBasisShort is for titles too short for the whole phrase. Data files write {hostedFeeText}, {hostedFeeShort}, {feeBasis}, {hostedFee} and {plusGst}, and src/lib/pricing.ts fills them in; scripts/verify.js checks the pages and llms.txt against it.
